From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Third-party risk declarations & insurance supplement for PO setup

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for moving quickly on the onboarding checklist. To get Greenfield set up in our procurement system and issue a PO, we need the following insurance / vendor risk items: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing current limits (GL: $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 agg; Auto: $1,000,000; Cyber: $1,000,000).
- Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees" (primary & non-contributory).
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where available.
- Claims history (past 3 years) if any claims >$25k — summary is fine.
- Completed supplier setup form: legal entity name, billing remit-to address, tax ID / W-9, and the AP contact for invoices.
- Any subcontractors list (if you use sub vendors who will handle customer data).

If you can send the COI and W-9 as PDFs, and indicate whether the Additional Insured language can be added to the endorsement, we can provisionally create a PO and queue activation. If you cannot add endorsements, please flag that — we have an exception process but it takes longer.

Target timeline: if we receive docs by EOD Thursday (9/9), procurement aims to issue a PO by Friday and route final endorsement confirmation to Legal for sign-off.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0192

Sofia —

Thanks for the checklist. Please find attached: Greenfield_Insurance_Declaration.pdf (COI + endorsement page) and Greenfield_W9.pdf.

Quick notes:
- We currently carry limits that meet or exceed the amounts you listed. The COI shows General Liability $2M/$4M, Auto $1M, and Cyber $1M.
- Our carrier can issue the Additional Insured endorsement naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." and make it primary and non-contributory; we just need the exact legal name you want on the endorsement (confirming the LLC / Inc punctuation).
- Waiver of subrogation: carrier indicated limited availability depending on jurisdiction; let us know if this is a hard blocker.
- Subcontractors: we use one subcontractor for data labeling (Lumina Labs). I attached a short subcontractor declaration in the COI notes.

If you need any revisions to the endorsement wording, I can request an endorsement addendum from our broker and send it over — should be 24–48 hours.

Liam O'Connor

Looping Legal / Procurement next steps —

Sofia, thanks for the upload. Two operational asks before we mark this green:

1) Please confirm the exact legal entity wording for the AI on the endorsement. We typically use: "Redwood Inference, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its affiliates." Can you confirm if Greenfield's broker can accept that?

2) We need the PO billing entity to match the W-9. Liam, confirm the invoice remit-to address and the name on the W-9 so AP can validate. Also, please confirm whether invoices will refer to products by Redwood PO number (we require PO number on invoices).

Marissa — procuring team, recommend issuing a conditional PO (PO-45213) pending receipt of finalized endorsement PDF that exactly matches the Additional Insured language. If Legal accepts the subcontractor declaration as-is, we can complete activation on sign-off.

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We've provisionally issued PO-45213 to Greenfield Systems in our procurement portal: https://procurement.redwood.com/po/PO-45213

Action items to close activation:
- Please have your broker issue the finalized Additional Insured endorsement PDF with the exact legal name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (matching W-9/PO name).
- If possible, include the PO number on the endorsement or on an accompanying cover email.
- If waiver of subrogation can be provided, attach it; if not, indicate jurisdictional constraint so we can document the exception.
- AP requires invoices to reference PO-45213 and remit to the address on the attached W-9.

Once we receive the endorsement PDF, Procurement will send the file to Legal for a final clearance (typically same day), and then we will move the PO to "Active" and notify your onboarding contact.
